No trap drops, oversized EDM builds or generic tropical-house clichés.

prompts.title: Sunset Drive

Crisp syncopated guitar, rolling bass, shakers, congas and tight contemporary percussion drive an infectious groove. Smooth melodic male vocal, catchy call-and-response phrasing, bright layered chorus, tasteful dub delays. Feel-good energy without sugary pop, polished but organic studio production.

prompts.title: Tides at Night

Intimate male vocal, muted guitar skanks, deep rounded bass, sparse percussion, airy pads and soft dub echoes. Bittersweet verses build toward a wide, hopeful melodic chorus. Honest, reflective, warm and coastal, with subtle dynamics rather than an EDM drop.

prompts.title: Coastal Deep House
prompts.text: Warm island deep house blending a mellow four-on-the-floor pulse with reggae guitar chops, soft shakers, gentle tropical percussion and smooth melodic bass. Airy synth atmosphere, restrained vocal fragments, patient transitions and a relaxed sunrise-to-sunset mood. Spacious, elegant, hypnotic, never festival EDM.

prompts.title: Crosscurrent
prompts.text: Minimal modern reggae-pop with a stronger reggaeton pulse, blending warm offbeat reggae guitar with tight syncopated dembow percussion and a deep, rolling melodic bassline. Crisp rimshots, shakers, hand drums, subtle piano accents and occasional dub echoes. Smooth, relaxed male lead vocals with rhythmic phrasing, conversational verses and infectious melodic hooks. Bright, confident, uplifting island energy with organic Caribbean warmth. Clean, spacious production, fluid transitions and groove-first arrangements. No aggressive trap, oversized EDM drops or generic tropical-house clichés.

prompts.title: Velvet Shore
prompts.text: Smooth reggae-pop fused with classic 90s R&B warmth and soulful melodic arrangements. Silky Rhodes electric piano, mellow offbeat guitar chops, rounded bass guitar, soft swung percussion, warm organ textures and understated dub delays. Expressive male lead vocals blend effortless reggae phrasing with soulful R&B melodies, tasteful runs, rich backing harmonies and smooth call-and-response choruses. Romantic, hopeful and emotionally mature atmosphere with a relaxed island pocket. Minimal instrumentation, analog warmth, spacious dynamics and polished studio clarity. No excessive vocal runs, trap rhythms or glossy commercial pop production.

prompts.title: Dub Garden
prompts.text: Minimal reggae-pop rooted in atmospheric dub and traditional sound-system culture. Deep, resonant melodic basslines, relaxed one-drop drums, warm guitar skanks, bubbling organ chords, sparse hand percussion, analog spring reverb and rhythmic tape-delay echoes. Intimate, soulful male vocals deliver thoughtful, uplifting melodies over wide open instrumental space. Brief dub instrumental passages let the bass, percussion and echoes breathe before returning to memorable vocal hooks. Earthy, meditative, optimistic and immersive with subtle psychedelic textures. Organic analog-style production, strong low-end separation and restrained arrangements. Avoid dense synth layers or aggressive EDM drops.

prompts.title: Neon Tides
prompts.text: Contemporary reggae-pop fused with melodic electronic dance music and subtle UK garage two-step rhythms. Warm offbeat guitar, fluid sub-bass, crisp shuffled percussion, atmospheric synth plucks, delicate arpeggios and airy electronic textures. Relaxed soulful male lead with memorable uplifting melodies, intimate verses and wide layered choruses. Gentle electronic buildups transition into groove-driven instrumental releases rather than explosive festival drops. Shimmering night-drive atmosphere, hypnotic movement and optimistic emotional energy. Preserve the reggae rhythmic foundation beneath modern electronic production. Spacious, detailed mixing with organic percussion and warm melodic bass.

prompts.title: Morning Light
prompts.text: Stripped-back acoustic reggae-pop with a natural, intimate island atmosphere. Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar, understated offbeat strumming, rounded live bass guitar, soft brushed drums, cajón, shakers and delicate hand percussion. Close, expressive male lead vocals with honest conversational phrasing and gentle melodic hooks. Minimal vocal harmonies open gradually into bright, uplifting choruses. Subtle organic room ambience, relaxed rhythmic swing and a warm live-session character. Reflective but optimistic, peaceful without becoming sleepy. Clean acoustic production with plenty of breathing room, no synthetic drops, excessive layers or sugary tropical clichés.

prompts.title: Golden Roots
prompts.text: Uplifting modern reggae-pop blended with vintage rocksteady, warm Caribbean soul and subtle classic ska influences. Bouncy melodic bass guitar, crisp offbeat rhythm guitar, playful piano accents, tight live drums, warm organ and restrained brass responses from trumpet and trombone. Smooth soulful male lead with confident melodic phrasing, lively backing harmonies and infectious singalong choruses. Bright rhythmic movement, timeless positivity and genuine live-band chemistry. Modern, clean studio production preserves the character of vintage instruments without sounding retro or theatrical. No novelty ska exaggeration, crowded horn arrangements or overproduced pop effects.

Distorted guitar grooves rise in the hooks without covering the jazz. Intimate rhythmic verses shift toward powerful melodic and aggressive metal vocals. Cinematic, immersive late-night atmosphere; polished studio production, not a live performance.

prompts.title: Midnight Slow Burn

Close-mic spoken and melodic vocal delivery, patient tension, distant guitar textures that gradually sharpen into a heavy groove. Moody neon-night introspection; no bright pop gloss.

prompts.text: Aggressive acid-jazz trap-metal with a prominent gritty tenor sax riff trading lines with down-tuned groove guitars. Thick 808s, syncopated live kick, sharp trap percussion, warm Rhodes stabs, explosive rhythm shifts and a massive heavy chorus. Alternate confident low-register rap with controlled harsh vocal bursts. Modern polished mix, deep bass and dramatic contrast.

prompts.title: Neon Cipher
prompts.text: Cinematic noir rap built on smoky jazz sax, Rhodes chords, dusty drum texture and modern trap sub bass. Precise crisp hats, sparse guitar dissonance, lyrical rhythmic male lead and a hypnotic nighttime pulse. Keep the arrangement spacious and moody; allow one intense distorted-guitar lift in the final section.

prompts.title: Brass & Bruises
prompts.text: High-energy fusion of dark big-band jazz, trap and groove-driven metalcore. Aggressive syncopated brass stabs, baritone sax growls, muted trumpet solos and restless walking bass collide with thunderous 808s, sharp trap hi-hats and down-tuned metal guitars. Swing-inflected jazz verses give way to crushing half-time choruses with heavy rhythmic guitar accents. Charismatic low-register male vocals alternate between smooth jazz phrasing, rapid rhythmic delivery and controlled harsh metal vocals. Unpredictable horn-and-guitar exchanges, sophisticated jazz harmony, explosive dynamics and a dangerous late-night club atmosphere. Tight, polished studio production.

prompts.title: Velvet Vice
prompts.text: Dark, seductive fusion of neo-soul, acid jazz, atmospheric metalcore and modern trap. Silky Rhodes chords, expressive tenor saxophone, warm fingerstyle bass and sophisticated extended jazz harmonies glide over deep 808 sub bass and intricate trap percussion. Intimate soulful male vocals use rich harmonies, smooth falsetto passages and restrained rhythmic phrasing. Gradually introduce down-tuned guitars, thick distorted bass layers and emotionally powerful metalcore choruses without sacrificing the soulful groove. Subtle vocal grit, atmospheric guitar leads and elegant instrumental transitions. Luxurious, hypnotic midnight atmosphere with spacious, detailed studio production and controlled dynamic contrast.

prompts.title: Crooked Clockwork
prompts.text: Technical progressive fusion of experimental jazz, djent-influenced metalcore and complex trap rhythms. Unpredictable time-signature changes, angular saxophone melodies, dissonant Rhodes voicings, syncopated seven-string guitar riffs and intricate live jazz drumming interlock with precise 808 patterns and rapid trap hi-hats. Shifting polyrhythms create tension while a recurring bass groove anchors the arrangement. Rhythmic male vocals alternate between syncopated rap, controlled melodic phrases and aggressive metalcore delivery. Emphasize instrumental virtuosity, unusual harmonic movement and sudden dynamic transitions without becoming chaotic. Dark, cerebral, mechanical and sophisticated, with pristine studio separation.

prompts.title: Static Noir
prompts.text: Futuristic fusion of industrial electronic music, noir acid jazz, trap and atmospheric metalcore. Cold analog synthesizers, distorted electronic bass, mechanical percussion and glitching trap hi-hats surround smoky saxophone phrases and minor-key Rhodes chords. Heavy down-tuned guitars introduce grinding rhythmic patterns and explosive metallic choruses. Deep male vocals shift between detached spoken rhythms, haunting melodic lines and forceful harsh delivery. Alternate sterile electronic verses with intensely organic jazz passages and crushing guitar-driven climaxes. Subtle digital distortion, evolving synth textures and precise rhythmic experimentation. Urban, claustrophobic and cinematic, with deep sub bass and polished modern production.

prompts.title: Devil's Blue Note
prompts.text: Gritty fusion of dark electric blues, smoky jazz, Southern trap and groove-heavy metalcore. Bent blues guitar notes, expressive tenor saxophone, dirty Hammond organ and warm Rhodes chords establish a slow swaggering groove. Heavy 808 sub bass, rolling trap hats and deep live drum accents support increasingly distorted low-tuned guitar riffs. Raspy soulful male vocals move between blues-inflected melodies, confident rhythmic rap and powerful metalcore aggression. Use blues-scale guitar solos, call-and-response between sax and electric guitar, gritty bass movement and unexpected heavy instrumental peaks. Raw emotional weight, hypnotic rhythmic swagger and a shadowy after-hours atmosphere. Organic instrumentation with modern studio punch.

prompts.title: Electric Masquerade
prompts.text: Sinister groove-driven fusion of dark jazz-funk, underground disco, modern trap and rhythmic metalcore. Slapping electric bass, syncopated wah guitar, muted brass stabs and slick Rhodes chords establish a hypnotic dance groove. Thick 808s, intricate trap hi-hats and punchy live drums build momentum beneath chromatic jazz harmonies. Introduce down-tuned metal guitars playing tight syncopated riffs that reinforce the funk rhythm rather than overpower it. Smooth charismatic male vocals alternate between rhythmic rap, seductive melodic hooks and controlled aggressive metal delivery. Gritty saxophone solos, unexpected heavy transitions and dark electronic accents. Stylish, dangerous and irresistibly rhythmic, with polished midnight-club production.

Cinematic spatial effects, dark futuristic textures, surreal transitions and a powerful low-end groove. Dreamlike but still hard-hitting.

Tight trap percussion, restless hi-hat patterns, syncopated 808 bass, chopped vocal accents and sharp synth stabs. Seductive, nocturnal and psychedelic, with warm analog textures, slow filter sweeps and immersive stereo depth. Maintain Southern swagger without forcing constant aggression.

prompts.text: Rap metal fused with industrial electronic drive around 104 BPM. Distorted synth bass, dark pulsing sequencers, mechanical percussion and driving electronic risers interlock with heavy syncopated guitars and thick hip-hop drums. Aggressive rap-led verses and an explosive melodic nu-metal chorus, with a controlled electronic drop that strengthens the riff instead of replacing it.

prompts.title: Early 2000s Impact
prompts.text: Heavy early-2000s nu-metal energy: detuned stop-start guitars, chest-hitting bass, hard live drums, restrained turntable texture and tense eerie verses. Rhythmic streetwise rap vocals alternate with urgent rough-edged melodic singing. Big emotionally charged chorus, thick layered guitar dynamics, raw grit and no modern pop-trap sheen.

prompts.title: Asphalt Funk
prompts.text: Underground 90s funk-metal and East Coast street-rap hybrid around 98 BPM. Rubbery slap-inflected bass, muted wah-guitar scratches, stop-start down-tuned riffs, dusty boom-bap kick, dry snare, ghost-note live drums and sparse DJ cuts. Gritty tightly pocketed male rap verses drive a muscular half-sung call-and-response rock hook. Focus on swagger, rhythmic push-pull and a raw basement-club mix. No disco gloss, glossy synths or trap sheen.

prompts.title: Underpass Cypher
prompts.text: Underground mid-90s cypher energy fused with stripped-down street rock around 92 BPM. Dusty sampled drum breaks, a deep relentless bassline, vinyl grit, tense minor-key guitar loops, hard snare cracks and occasional turntable cuts. Fierce articulate male rap verses with shifting cadences stay front and center while short distorted guitar replies punctuate the bars. Refrain is shouted and memorable rather than polished or pop-melodic. Raw concrete-room feel, no trap drums or radio sheen.

prompts.title: Rusted Frequency
prompts.text: Dark analog-industrial rap rock grounded in 90s street hip-hop. Crunchy looped breakbeats, heavy sub-bass, rusty gated guitar riffs, metallic percussion, tape-warble and distant radio-static textures. Tight confrontational male rap verses cut through sparse mechanical grooves; the chorus expands into a rough melodic alternative-metal hook with a powerful live-kit lift. Keep it gritty and claustrophobic, with electronics as unsettling texture rather than a dance drop. No glossy futuristic EDM production.

prompts.title: Curbside Riot
prompts.text: Explosive 90s hardcore punk and underground street-rap collision around 112 BPM. Razor-edged palm-muted guitar chords, overdriven bass, hard live drums with rapid snare fills and a heavy hip-hop backbeat. Commanding rhythmically precise male rap verses snap into raw gang-shouted refrains and short muscular riff breaks. Tense, fast, confrontational and tightly arranged, with gritty rehearsal-room punch. Preserve the hip-hop groove beneath the punk velocity; avoid metalcore breakdowns, pop hooks and synthetic trap polish.

prompts.title: Concrete Soul
prompts.text: Soul-stained underground rap rock with a 90s East Coast backbone and restrained alternative-metal weight. Warm Rhodes chords, dusty soul-sample fragments, a thick melodic bassline and laid-back boom-bap drums sit beneath clean-to-gritty electric guitar swells. Intimate incisive male rap verses give way to a worn soulful sung refrain, then a heavy guitar-driven chorus release. Cinematic but street-level, reflective without sentimentality. Keep the rhythm organic and the vocals human; no glossy R&B production or modern trap effects.

groups.name: Enter The End
groups.description: Low-tuned guitars, tribal percussion and vocal dynamics

prompts.title: ETE Core
prompts.text: Groove-heavy modern metalcore with downtuned syncopated guitars, thick distorted bass, explosive live drums, double-kick bursts and subtle tribal or Latin-inspired percussion. Male vocals shift between gritty rhythmic delivery, powerful clean tenor and controlled harsh screams. Dark alternative-metal atmosphere, hard-driving verses and enormous melodic choruses. Deep articulate low end, sharp guitar attack and occasional expressive guitar solo. No short gimmicky scream-only breakdowns.

prompts.title: No Mercy
prompts.text: Full-force modern metalcore with relentless aggressive down-tuned guitar riffs, thick distorted bass, hard-hitting live drums, fast double-kick runs and urgent tribal percussion. Controlled vicious screams, gritty rhythm-led verse delivery and a forceful clean male chorus. Tight low-end punch, evolving heavy instrumental breaks and an expressive lead-guitar solo. No trap or electronic gloss.

prompts.title: Pressure System
prompts.text: Dark groove-metalcore slow burn built from pulsing low guitar, deep bass, tom-driven percussion and dissonant atmosphere. Verses feel claustrophobic with restrained gritty male vocals, then pressure surges through syncopated riffs, live drums and urgent clean-sung hooks. Gradually increase density until a long instrumental release and emotive guitar solo. No cheap sudden scream breakdown.

prompts.title: Evil Disco
prompts.text: Sinister disco pulse fused with modern groove metalcore. Four-on-the-floor kick and tight syncopated funk bass beneath menacing downtuned guitar riffs, eerie minor-key synth accents, crisp live drums and tribal percussion. Gritty male rhythmic vocals shift into dark powerful clean hooks and selective harsh screams. Grotesque dance-floor tension with legitimate metal weight; never novelty or campy.

prompts.title: Nightmare Industrial
prompts.text: Nightmarish industrial metalcore with mechanical beats, grinding low guitars, corrupted synth textures, thick bass, unsettling ambience and tight human drum attacks. Claustrophobic rhythmic male lead, distorted whispered layers, explosive controlled harsh vocals and dark melodic choruses. Build eerie tension through repetition and abrasive detail; cold cinematic studio mix, no crowd sound.

prompts.title: Tribal Storm
prompts.text: Groove-forward metalcore with huge down-tuned rhythmic guitars, powerful live kick and snare, rolling toms, Latin-inspired hand percussion and thick bass. Controlled rhythmic verses, strong clean male tenor and selectively aggressive accents. Low-slung hypnotic movement, massive chorus and prominent guitar-led instrumental section, not nonstop blast beats.

prompts.title: Blackwater Blues
prompts.text: Southern blues-infused groove metalcore with crushing downtuned guitars, gritty blues-scale riffs, thick distorted bass, swampy rhythmic swagger and explosive live drums. Subtle Latin tribal percussion reinforces the groove. Soulful gritty male verses shift between dark blues-influenced melodic phrasing, controlled aggressive screams and massive powerful clean tenor choruses. Heavy syncopated guitar chugs, ominous atmospheric passages, expressive wah-inflected lead guitar and an extended blues-metal solo with screaming bends. Raw, dangerous and deeply rhythmic. No country twang, no gimmicky breakdowns.

prompts.title: Fractured Time
prompts.text: Progressive groove metalcore driven by low-tuned seven-string guitars, intricate syncopated djent riffs, shifting time signatures, deep distorted bass and dynamic live drumming. Polyrhythmic kick patterns interlock with rolling tribal percussion while atmospheric dissonant guitars create tension. Gritty rhythmic male verses alternate with controlled harsh screams and soaring melodic clean tenor choruses. Build through evolving riffs, unexpected rhythmic transitions and expansive instrumental passages featuring a technically fluid melodic guitar solo. Modern, muscular and sophisticated, maintaining infectious grooves beneath the complexity. No robotic repetition or abrupt scream-only breakdowns.

prompts.title: Velvet Ruin
prompts.text: Dark contemporary R&B fused with crushing groove metalcore. Smooth atmospheric electric piano, haunting synth pads and deep soulful bass weave around downtuned syncopated guitar riffs, explosive live drums and subtle Latin percussion. Expressive male vocals alternate between intimate soulful R&B melodies, gritty rhythmic phrasing, powerful clean tenor belts and selective controlled screams. Verses breathe with spacious late-night atmosphere before erupting into massive heavy guitar-driven choruses. Rich layered vocal harmonies, dynamic rhythmic contrast and a soaring melodic electric guitar solo. Sensual tension meets genuine metal aggression, never glossy pop or lightweight rock.

prompts.title: Cathedral Collapse
prompts.text: Cinematic atmospheric metalcore combining crushing downtuned groove riffs, thick bass, powerful live drums and rolling tribal percussion with ominous orchestral strings, low brass, haunting choirs and distant piano. Dark spacious verses feature restrained gritty male vocals and atmospheric guitar textures, building toward thunderous syncopated riffs, selective harsh screams and towering clean tenor choruses. Dramatic orchestral swells enhance the guitars without overpowering them. Slow-building tension, enormous dynamic contrasts, a sweeping melodic guitar solo and a devastating instrumental climax. Epic, sinister and emotionally intense, never theatrical novelty or symphonic power metal.

prompts.title: Overdrive Riot
prompts.text: High-velocity thrash-infused groove metalcore with razor-sharp downtuned guitar riffs, galloping palm-muted rhythms, thick distorted bass, punishing live drums and relentless double-kick acceleration. Aggressive hardcore energy collides with syncopated alternative-metal grooves and rapid tribal percussion fills. Ferocious gritty male verses, controlled harsh screams and forceful clean tenor choruses with commanding melodic hooks. Fast technical riff exchanges, driving rhythmic transitions, explosive extended guitar solos and muscular half-time passages that sustain the momentum. Raw, confrontational and fiercely energetic with polished modern production. No electronic dance elements or short gimmicky breakdowns.

groups.name: 4th Movement
groups.description: Violins, viola and cello over urban beats and 808s

prompts.title: Quartet Core
prompts.text: Cinematic string-quartet hip-hop led by expressive violins, rich viola counterlines, warm cello ostinatos and minor-key piano over punchy drums and deep 808 sub bass. Strings carry the hooks with agile riffs, pizzicato, emotional swells and dramatic rests. Gritty but refined urban rap delivery, modern trap and boom-bap hybrid pocket, high-definition studio mix. Keep the quartet prominent, never background wallpaper.

prompts.title: Sinister Trap
prompts.text: Dark aggressive quartet trap with sharp staccato violin ostinatos, low cello repetitions, tense viola harmonies, minor piano stabs and ominous orchestral stops. Booming slightly distorted 808, intricate hats, hard snare and confident low-register rap. Cinematic danger with disciplined string writing and heavy street swagger.

prompts.title: Future Chamber
prompts.text: Modern quartet hip-hop meets melodic future bass. Expressive violin lead and cello ostinatos anchor pulsing synth sub bass, crisp trap drums, atmospheric pads and carefully sidechained electronic lifts. String motifs remain recognizable through the drop; emotionally charged rap verses and a sweeping cinematic hook. No generic festival supersaw overload.

prompts.title: Low Strings
prompts.text: Patient cinematic hip-hop slow burn with intimate cello melody, soft viola layers, sparse expressive violin, felt piano, dusty boom-bap drums and deep rounded bass. Reflective streetwise male rap, delicate tension and a gradual string swell into a controlled soulful hook. Spacious, human and restrained.

prompts.title: Street Symphony
prompts.text: Hard 90s East Coast rap with gritty boom-bap kick and crisp snare, ominous minor-key piano, low cello bass and cutting violin motifs. Tight acoustic string quartet drives the beat with repeating ostinatos and dramatic stops; raw confident street storytelling vocals, thick low end and no EDM effects.

prompts.title: Sleigh Bell Cipher
prompts.text: Christmas hip-hop fused with a cinematic string quartet: agile violin melodies, warm cello groove, rich viola harmonies and minor piano under hard crisp trap drums and deep 808s. Sleigh bells and light chimes weave through the rhythm instead of taking over. Playful confident rap storytelling, festive atmosphere with real street credibility and no cartoon vocals.

prompts.title: Christmas Crunk
prompts.text: 4th Movement Christmas crunk anthem fusion: aggressive string quartet over huge Southern crunk drums, stomping kicks, snapping snares, booming 808 bass, chant-ready rhythms, sharp violin riffs, low cello ostinatos and dramatic orchestral hits. Layer sleigh bells and jingle percussion into the beat. Bold high-energy verses, forceful group chant hook and a hard celebratory groove; playful but not corny.

groups.name: Oblivion
groups.description: Cosmic progressive rock, intricate rhythms, soaring guitar and cinematic post-rock atmosphere

prompts.title: Event Horizon
prompts.text: Atmospheric progressive rock with celestial post-rock expansiveness and intricate progressive metal musicianship. Crystalline clean guitar arpeggios, soaring melodic leads, complex bass movement, expressive drums with shifting time signatures, and vast analog synthesizer textures. Balance technical instrumental passages with emotionally powerful melodies, cosmic ambience, and slow-building crescendos. Expressive clean male vocals with spacious harmonies, extended instrumental sections, fluid guitar solos, and a cinematic sense of scale. Organic, expansive production with exceptional instrumental clarity.

prompts.title: Astral Drift
prompts.text: Ethereal instrumental progressive post-rock drifting through expansive celestial soundscapes. Delicate delay-soaked guitar arpeggios, shimmering reverberant leads, warm synthesizer drones, deep melodic bass, and restrained atmospheric percussion. Gradual harmonic evolution, subtle rhythmic complexity, and enormous emotional crescendos emerging from near silence. Clean guitars slowly transform into towering walls of luminous distortion before fading into cosmic ambience. No vocals. Spacious cinematic production, organic dynamics, hypnotic melodic repetition, and an immense sense of isolation and wonder.

prompts.title: Quantum Architecture
prompts.text: Highly technical progressive rock and metal with sophisticated polyrhythms, rapidly shifting meters, intricate guitar and keyboard interplay, and virtuosic instrumental passages. Precision drumming, fluid melodic bass runs, angular guitar riffs, cascading synthesizer sequences, and elaborate unison instrumental sections. Alternate complex high-energy movements with spacious celestial interludes and soaring melodic themes. Extended guitar and keyboard solos, unexpected transitions, and dynamic progressive arrangements. Primarily instrumental with meticulous yet organic production and strong melodic continuity.

prompts.title: Dying Sun
prompts.text: Melancholic atmospheric progressive rock with slow-burning celestial post-rock arrangements. Fragile clean guitar melodies, haunting piano, distant analog synth pads, warm fretless-style bass, and restrained live drums. Gradually introduce layered harmonies, subtle odd-meter passages, and emotionally expressive guitar leads. Intimate clean male vocals float above spacious verses before the arrangement develops into towering distorted guitar crescendos and soaring melodic solos. Patient pacing, dramatic dynamic contrast, bittersweet harmonic movement, and expansive cinematic production.

prompts.title: Gravitational Collapse
prompts.text: Dark atmospheric progressive metal with crushing low-tuned guitar riffs, shifting polymetric grooves, thunderous live drums, prominent technical bass, and ominous celestial synthesizers. Powerful distorted guitar movements contrast with crystalline clean passages and vast post-rock atmospheres. Complex rhythmic transitions, fluid instrumental interplay, melodic lead guitar solos, and explosive dynamic crescendos. Strong clean male vocals with dramatic melodic intensity, layered harmonies, and soaring refrains. Heavy but never chaotic, maintaining space, emotional depth, intricate composition, and cinematic production.

prompts.title: Tidal Mechanics
prompts.text: Rhythmically adventurous progressive rock driven by intricate melodic bass lines, syncopated guitar patterns, and highly expressive live drumming. Interlocking instrumental grooves, fluid odd-time signatures, luminous analog keyboards, and sweeping celestial guitar textures. Energetic progressive arrangements shift effortlessly between tight rhythmic passages, airy atmospheric breakdowns, and soaring melodic guitar solos. Clear melodic male vocals with memorable progressive rock phrasing and layered harmonies. Warm organic production, punchy bass presence, and a balance of technical precision and natural groove.

prompts.title: Nebula Cathedral
prompts.text: Majestic symphonic progressive rock blending intricate electric guitar arrangements, sweeping orchestral strings, celestial synthesizers, resonant piano, and powerful organic drums. Expansive harmonic progressions, sophisticated rhythmic changes, atmospheric post-rock passages, and towering cinematic crescendos. Lyrical lead guitar solos weave through layered orchestral textures and evolving synthesizer melodies. Expressive clean male vocals supported by ethereal choral harmonies and dramatic melodic refrains. Grand yet intimate, balancing progressive complexity with emotional depth and vast cosmic atmosphere.

prompts.title: Pulsar Engine
prompts.text: Futuristic progressive rock merging intricate live musicianship with pulsing analog synthesizer sequences and atmospheric electronic textures. Propulsive bass grooves, precise odd-meter drums, arpeggiated synth patterns, crystalline delayed guitars, and soaring melodic leads. Layered electronic rhythms evolve beneath organic progressive rock arrangements, creating hypnotic momentum and expansive celestial atmosphere. Occasional heavy guitar surges, extended synthesizer and guitar solos, and dramatic instrumental transitions. Clean melodic vocals with subtle electronic processing, wide stereo production, and luminous futuristic energy.

prompts.title: Perpetual Motion
prompts.text: Energetic melodic progressive rock with bright interlocking guitar riffs, adventurous bass melodies, dynamic live percussion, and vibrant analog keyboard passages. Rapid but fluid rhythmic changes, occasional odd-time grooves, extended instrumental bridges, and exhilarating melodic guitar solos. Maintain an uplifting celestial atmosphere through shimmering synth layers, expansive reverberant guitars, and memorable harmonic progressions. Strong expressive clean male vocals with soaring choruses and sophisticated melodic phrasing. Lively organic production, clear instrumental separation, and constant forward momentum.

prompts.title: The Empty Between
prompts.text: Minimalist atmospheric progressive rock built around intimate clean guitar fingerpicking, delicate piano motifs, soft analog synthesizer drones, melodic bass, and sparse expressive percussion. Subtle unconventional time signatures, patient harmonic development, and gently shifting instrumental textures create an introspective celestial atmosphere. Quiet clean male vocals with restrained emotional delivery and distant layered harmonies. Occasional expressive lead guitar phrases emerge from long ambient passages without overwhelming the arrangement. Warm spacious production, natural dynamics, and profound emotional restraint.

prompts.title: Infinite Spiral
prompts.text: Psychedelic atmospheric progressive rock with swirling vintage analog synthesizers, hypnotic guitar delay patterns, fluid bass grooves, and intricate evolving drum rhythms. Repeating melodic motifs gradually transform through unconventional chord progressions, shifting meters, extended instrumental improvisation, and expansive post-rock crescendos. Introduce expressive wah-inflected guitar solos, vintage keyboard leads, reverse guitar textures, and immersive celestial ambience. Sparse ethereal male vocals with subtle layered harmonies. Organic psychedelic production, deep stereo movement, and an immersive cosmic character.

prompts.title: Beyond the Observable
prompts.text: Epic multi-movement progressive rock blending technical progressive metal, expansive celestial post-rock, symphonic textures, and atmospheric ambient passages. Begin with delicate piano, crystalline guitar, and distant synthesizer drones before evolving into intricate odd-meter rhythms, powerful melodic vocals, elaborate guitar and keyboard interplay, and soaring instrumental solos. Reprise musical themes across contrasting movements, alternating heavy rhythmic sections with weightless ambient interludes. Build toward a monumental emotionally uplifting finale with layered guitars, orchestral synthesizers, and cinematic crescendos. Grand organic production.

groups.name: Alan Walker Band
groups.description: Whiskey-soaked electric blues, weathered Southern storytelling, soulful guitar solos and hard-hitting trap grooves

prompts.title: Whiskey & Wire
prompts.text: Modern whiskey-soaked blues rock fused with Southern hip-hop grit and restrained trap percussion. Stinging electric blues guitar bends, warm organ, thick bass guitar, live kick and snare layered with deep 808 weight and crisp rolling hats. Weathered, soulful male lead moves between conversational half-rapped storytelling and raspy melodic choruses. Strong call-and-response guitar fills, smoky late-night atmosphere, authentic band dynamics and a memorable blues-rock hook. Polished but rough-edged production; no EDM drops or cartoonish trap ad-libs.

prompts.title: Backroad 808
prompts.text: Southern blues-trap with a deep rolling 808, sharp snare, syncopated trap hats and swampy electric guitar riffs. Low, gravelly male verses delivered in rhythmic spoken-sung cadence, opening into a soulful blues-rock chorus. Bottleneck slide guitar answers the vocal phrases; live bass and kick add physical weight under the programmed groove. Backroad swagger, dusty harmonica accents, dark minor-key tension and confident head-nod pacing. Keep the blues instruments upfront, the trap low end tight, and the production raw but clear.

prompts.title: Rustbelt Revival
prompts.text: Hard-driving contemporary blues rock with fiery Texas-style lead guitar, muscular live drums, thick bass and a subtle modern trap undercurrent. Raw male vocal swagger, gritty rhythmic verses, big unpolished melodic hooks and extended expressive guitar solos with sustained bends and biting vibrato. Distorted rhythm guitars push a heavy shuffle into a straight-ahead stomping chorus while sparse 808 hits reinforce the downbeats. Sweat, grit and road-worn conviction; wide analog guitar tones with punchy modern low end, never generic arena rock.

prompts.title: Last Call Lament
prompts.text: Intimate late-night whiskey blues with a slow hip-hop heartbeat and restrained trap textures. Fingerpicked electric guitar, aching slide bends, muted rimshot snare, sparse 808 pulses, distant Hammond organ and warm bass guitar leave air around a cracked, soulful male voice. Half-spoken verses feel like confessions across an empty bar; a weary melodic refrain slowly blooms into a searing guitar solo. Dark, reflective and human, with natural room ambience, patient dynamics and no oversized drop or glossy pop vocal treatment.

prompts.title: Delta After Dark
prompts.text: Dusty Delta-inspired blues colliding with hypnotic minimalist trap. Raw resonator and bottleneck slide guitar, foot-stomp percussion, ghostly harmonica, deep sub bass, ticking hi-hats and a dry backbeat. A rough, expressive male lead trades rhythmic talk-singing for moaning blues refrains, with short guitar answers between lines. Keep the arrangement sparse, repetitive and magnetic, building tension through changing slide phrases rather than adding layers. Swamp air, weathered wood, midnight crossroads atmosphere and an earthy contemporary mix.

prompts.title: Smokestack Gospel
prompts.text: Soulful blues-rock and Southern gospel warmth over a slow, hard hip-hop pocket. Hammond organ swells, expressive electric guitar, thick bass, clapping backbeat, warm piano and subdued 808 accents support a weathered male lead with powerful blues phrasing. Background gospel harmonies lift the chorus without turning it into a full choir spectacle. Verses carry hard-lived storytelling; a soaring guitar solo rises after the final chorus. Spiritual tension, redemption and smoke-filled soul, with honest analog textures and modern drum clarity.

prompts.title: Barrelhouse Bounce
prompts.text: Up-tempo barrelhouse blues-rock with a swinging boogie piano, clipped electric-guitar riffs, walking bass and a greasy live drum shuffle interlocked with trap hats and selective 808 thumps. Gravelly male sing-rap verses snap tightly to the groove; a catchy rough-edged chorus invites call-and-response without novelty. Harmonica punches and bright slide licks answer the vocal, leading to an energetic blues guitar break. Barroom electricity, loose shoulders, unmistakable Southern bounce and tight modern studio punch.

prompts.title: Midnight Switchblade
prompts.text: Dark cinematic blues-trap with ominous tremolo guitar, haunted organ drones, low slide-guitar cries and a sparse heartbeat kick beneath sub-heavy 808s. Crisp trap percussion cuts through roomy live snare accents. A deep, smoky male vocal delivers tense half-rapped verses before climbing into a desperate, melodic blues-rock refrain. Minor-key guitar motifs evolve into a long, emotional solo as distorted guitars surge near the ending. Dangerous neon-noir atmosphere, deliberate pacing, dramatic restraint and a gritty widescreen mix.

prompts.title: Broken Neon
prompts.text: Moody whiskey blues fused with 90s soul warmth and contemporary trap drums. Velvet Rhodes chords, clean electric guitar with expressive blues bends, rounded bass, brushed snare details, soft trap hats and controlled 808 sub create a late-night pocket. An intimate, husky male voice alternates between melodic R&B phrasing and grounded storytelling rap; layered backing harmonies widen an aching chorus. Subtle organ and guitar-response lines keep the roots intact. Warm, intimate and understated, with no glossy vocal runs or oversized synthetic builds.

prompts.title: Fuzz & Gravel
prompts.text: Heavy blues-rock trap built from snarling fuzz guitar, low swaggering riffs, punchy live toms, thick electric bass and a gritty half-time 808 groove. Tough, raspy male vocals deliver clipped rhythmic verses and a forceful, soulful blues chorus. Stuttering hi-hats and hard snare cracks create modern urgency while slide guitar, wah inflections and a muscular improvised solo keep the sound unmistakably rooted in blues. Dark garage-room attitude, dynamic stops and raw distortion with clean low-frequency separation; not metalcore or festival trap.

prompts.title: Porchlight Confession
prompts.text: Stripped-down acoustic whiskey blues with a quiet trap-inflected pulse. Weathered fingerpicked steel-string guitar, intimate dobro slide, warm upright-style bass, soft brushed percussion, distant 808 heartbeat and barely audible hi-hat ticks. A close-miked gravelly male storyteller moves between low spoken-sung verses and a fragile, soulful chorus. Small harmonica phrases and delicate guitar fills create space between lines. Southern night stillness, tape warmth, unresolved emotion and restrained organic production; no dense electronics or stadium-sized arrangement.

prompts.title: Blacktop Thunder
prompts.text: High-energy Southern blues-rock and trap crossover with sharp electric guitar hooks, driving live drums, rolling bass, commanding 808 downbeats and syncopated trap fills. Gritty, charismatic male verses use tight hip-hop cadence; the chorus breaks wide into a full-throated blues-rock melody with backing shouts kept tasteful. Push the bridge into an extended blazing guitar solo with expressive bends, fast blues runs and a final band-wide stop before the last refrain. Highway-at-night momentum, whiskey grit, triumphant resilience and a polished, powerful mix.
